ring.title: 👁️ **Herr Hans Gestapo Persecutor**
ring.description: Ze Gestapo officer vill persecute you to ze end of time, accuse other soldiers to avoid zat torment.
ring.status_active: ✅ **ACTIVE PERSECUTION** - Her Hans is looking for traitors
ring.investigation_instructions:
• ACHTUNG! Use **Accuse** from ze operations menu, soldier
• Enter suspect identification: @username or ID
• Herr Hans vill generate interrogation to extract confession
• Ze accusation vill be published in headquarters for all soldiers
ring.investigation_warning:
⚠️ **REICH ORDERS:**
• Cannot accuse yourself, traitor
• Cannot accuse automated units (bots)
• Persecution must be authorized by superior officer
ring.inactive_instructions:
ACHTUNG! To authorize persecution operations:
• A superior officer must access **Admin**
• And authorize persecution
• Set automatic interrogation frequency

Once authorized, you can accuse soldiers of treason to ze Reich!
ring.controls:
**Controls**
- Activate or deactivate persecution
- Editable frequency box (sets base frequency and restarts hot potato)

dropdown.ring_accuse_description: Accuse a soldier of being a traitor to ze Reich
dropdown.ring_on_description: Start ze persecution of Reich traitors
